Method of Attack: Enterprise-targeting ransomware that compromises corporate networks, gains admin credentials, encrypts devices, steals files before encryption, and uses stolen files for extortion by leaking them publicly if ransom is not paid
Impacted Systems: Corporate networks, Hundreds to thousands of devices in enterprise environments
Attack Vector: Compromise of corporate network and admin credentials
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen files published on leak site
Victim companies including Pemex, a merchant account company (USA), a French cloud hosting and telecom company, and a South African logistics & supply chain company
